from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityItem(BaseModel):
    """An equity line item extracted from a company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the equity line item (e.g., 'Additional paid-in capital')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_items: list[EquityItem]
